panels.title: Fraud Risk Triage: unreviewed queue backlog

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as backlog from fraud_risk_score where review_outcome is null

panels.title: Fraud Risk Triage: determinations scored per day

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(scored_at, '1d') as time, count(*) as scored
from fraud_risk_score
where $__timeFilter(scored_at)
group by 1
order by 1

panels.title: QC / Payment Error: unreviewed discrepancy backlog

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as backlog from payment_error_review where review_outcome is null and error_amount <> 0

panels.title: QC / Payment Error: determinations sampled per day

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(sampled_at, '1d') as time, count(*) as sampled
from payment_error_review
where $__timeFilter(sampled_at)
group by 1
order by 1
